name: Mikuni Yuuji
source:
The protagonist.

He is a pitiful young man who was kicked out of his parents' house due to being a ronin.

He is not good with women, probably because he went to a boys' school.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/tmhv.html]official site[/url]]
